entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: A large-scale war fought on Corondor in 4196 AR that pitted powerful planeswalkers against one another.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: The land on Dominaria where the Planeswalker War was fought and which was scarred by it.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: The treacherous battlemage and student of Taysir whose machinations lie at the heart of the war; he is lost in a sinkhole beneath Hamath.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A character who resists Ravidel, partner of Kristina and father of Justina, and who accepts his destiny as Corondor's Elder Druid.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Ravidel's master and the father of Daria, who denounces Ravidel and later reconciles with Sandruu.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Taysir's daughter, imprisoned in an Amber Prison on the Null Moon by Tevesh Szat and Leshrac and later freed.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker, mother of Justina, who grabs the Grey Chime and escapes to the Blind Eternities, losing her spark.

entities.name: Justina Carthalion
entities.description: The daughter of Jared and Kristina, born at the war's lead-up.

entities.name: Elder Druid of Corondor
entities.description: A druid who bore the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid and warned of the coming war.

entities.name: Yorgo
entities.description: Ruler of the ruins of Arathoxia who led the Elder Druid to Jared.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: An isolationist panther warrior on Urborg who dismisses Ravidel's recruitment attempt.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who foresaw the danger of the Mox Beacon and aided Jared's allies.

entities.name: Lord of House Khone
entities.description: An enigmatic lord who convened a war council and whose hidden identity Freyalise keeps secret.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: A being summoned and bound by Freyalise and the Lord of Khone so that Ravidel's black magic feeds Freyalise.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A ruthless planeswalker drawn to Corondor by the Mox Beacon who pursues the Grey Chime.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A sinister planeswalker who convinces Szat to imprison Daria and later rings the Grey Chime.

entities.name: Eskil the White
entities.description: A resident of the White Woods burdened by the sins of his ancestor Xarl, who helps Embereck and Shikarans and frees Daria.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: An Ash Warlord drawn by the Mox Beacon who once retrieved the Golgothian Sylex; he dies fighting Ravidel.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: A minotaur with lingering feelings for Kristina who is manipulated by Ravidel.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: Jared's grandfather, whom Szat attacks to learn the secret of the Grey Chime.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time-mage who intervenes against Ravidel, sets a trap for him, and retrieves Daria's Amber Prison.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A warrior summoned by Jared whose forces rout Ravidel's and who protects Jared's family.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: The owner of the spellbook that Jared retrieved from Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: A device that drew planeswalkers such as Tevesh Szat and Embereck to Corondor.

entities.name: Grey Chime
entities.description: An artifact of devastating power scattered in fragments among Corondor's five noble houses; its detonation left the skies stained.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: A prison in which Daria is held on the Null Moon.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: A moon high above Dominaria where Daria waited and was imprisoned.

entities.name: Telemar
entities.description: A city of Corondor destroyed in a mushroom-cloud explosion.

entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: A city conquered by Ravidel and one of Corondor's lost cities.

entities.name: Hamath
entities.description: A city beneath which a huge sinkhole formed, swallowing Ravidel.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: Ruins where Jared and Sandruu clashed.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The island where Ravidel tried to recruit Lord Windgrace.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The place between planes to which Kristina planeswalked.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Corondor lies.

events.summary: The Elder Druid of Corondor finds Jared with Yorgo's help and warns of the coming war while Jared tends to Kristina as she gives birth to Justina.
events.quote: The Elder Druid, revealing that he bore the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid, warned of the coming war and the necessity of preparation.

events.summary: Ravidel visits Urborg to recruit Lord Windgrace, who rejects him; Ravidel takes a shard of Urborgan obsidian.
events.quote: Before departing, Ravidel took a shard of Urborgan obsidian with him

events.summary: Freyalise interrupts the Lord of House Khone's war council, and together they bind Sol'Kanar the Swamp King.
events.quote: Together, they summoned and bound Sol’Kanar the Swamp King

events.summary: Embereck destroys Eskil's hut, but Eskil takes him to New Argive, and Embereck learns of Ravidel's deceit and agrees to stand against him.
events.quote: Embereck agreed to stand against him.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and Leshrac convinces Szat to imprison Daria in an Amber Prison rather than kill her.
events.quote: proposing that she instead be imprisoned within an Amber Prison .

events.summary: Ravidel manipulates Sandruu with misleading images of Kristina and Jared, enraging him.
events.quote: Showing Sandruu misleading images of Kristina with Jared, he stoked the minotaur’s fury.

events.summary: Jared retrieves Geyadrone Dihada's spellbook at Castle Melmereth despite Sandruu's interference.
events.quote: Though he struggled, Jared managed to escape with the spellbook.

events.summary: Ravidel conquers Shikar and assembles an artifact that suppresses the spellcasting of planeswalkers.
events.quote: The finished artifact was activated, suppressing the spellcasting of the Planeswalkers drawn into the war.

events.summary: Szat attacks Grenfell Mor to learn the secret of the Grey Chime and leaves Telemar to find its fragments.
events.quote: Szat abandoned Telemar to pursue the chime’s fragments.

events.summary: Embereck dies fighting Ravidel and Leshrac flees; Taysir then confronts Ravidel, who nearly defeats his mentor until Teferi intervenes.
events.quote: Embereck perished in the battle, and Leshrac fled.

events.summary: Szat gathers the fragments of the Grey Chime; Kristina, Sandruu and Freyalise assault Telemar.
events.quote: Kristina, Sandruu, and Freyalise launched their assault on Telemar.

events.summary: Leshrac rings the Grey Chime; Kristina grabs it and planeswalks to the Blind Eternities as Telemar is destroyed in a mushroom cloud.
events.quote: Kristina grabbed the chime and planeswalked to the Blind Eternities as Telemar went up in a mushroom cloud.

events.summary: Ravidel's summoning backfires, a sinkhole forms under Hamath, and he plunges into the abyss while Dakkon routs his forces; he is assumed dead.
events.quote: Ravidel was not heard from again and was assumed to be dead.

events.summary: Kristina reappears, having lost her planeswalker spark; she and Jared choose mortal lives and Jared accepts becoming Elder Druid.
events.quote: She had managed to escape the explosion but had lost her Planeswalker spark in the process.

events.summary: Taysir reconciles with Sandruu, and Teferi and Eskil free Daria from the Amber Prison.
events.quote: Teferi retrieved Daria's Amber Prison, and with Eskil’s help, freed her at last.

relations.quote: was soon confronted by his master, Taysir.
Daria awaited her father, Taysir , on the Null Moon .
Kristina of the Woods as she gave birth to their daughter, Justina Carthalion .

relations.note: Rekindled an old ambition to conquer the world together.
relations.quote: Szat and Leshrac rekindled an old ambition — to conquer the world.

relations.note: Jared and his allies resist Ravidel.
relations.quote: the desperate struggles of Jared Carthalion , Taysir , and their allies to resist him

relations.note: Vowed to keep his secrets safe and worked with him.
relations.quote: she vowed to keep his secrets safe.
exploiting his lingering feelings for Kristina
Szat, unwilling to leave witnesses, intended to kill her

relations.note: Intervened to save Taysir from Ravidel.
relations.quote: nearly defeating his mentor until the time-mage Teferi could intervene.
